recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast stage portrait of a male performer in a white, ornate jumpsuit against a deep black background, featuring a top-left justified typographic block with a rainbow-gradient background and bold, sans-serif lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically but offset horizontally to the right
Typographic block balances the negative space on the left
High-key lighting on the subject against a low-key black void
Warm skin tones and white fabric contrasting with a vibrant, multi-colored graphic box
coreInvariants: Single-point stage lighting creating deep shadows
Top-left alignment for the primary title block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body performer from thighs up, positioned slightly right of center, occupying 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The performer's face and pointing hand serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright title block in the top left, moves down to the performer's face, and follows the gesture of the arm.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space surrounding the subject, emphasizing the spotlight effect.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rainbow spectrum (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Pink) in the title block
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and background; high saturation only within the graphic title box.
paletteRestrictions: Vibrant primary and secondary spectrum colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with color variation to distinguish lines.
graphicDevices: Rectangular container with concentric rainbow stripes
Solid black border around the title box

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed proportions.
Provides the ultra-condensed, blocky feel of 70s display type.
Offers a similar industrial sans-serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a male performer in a white 1970s studded jumpsuit, pointing his finger, illuminated by a single spotlight against a solid black background. Leave the top-left quadrant empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rectangular box in the top-left corner. The top half of the box should have a concentric rainbow gradient background with white bold condensed sans-serif text. Below the box, add a second line of text in yellow bold condensed sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast stage lighting?
Is the text in the top-left corner?
Does the title box feature a rainbow motif?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors in the rainbow gradient
postGenerationChecks: Check for sharp contrast between subject and background
Ensure text is legible against the rainbow background
Verify the 'spotlight' effect on the costume texture
Confirm the top-left alignment of the graphic block
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast stage portrait with a top-left justified, color-blocked typographic element to create a vintage music aesthetic.
